_note: Energy is estimated per token at the server (Wh per 1,000 tokens), then multiplied by data-center overhead (PUE). Providers do not publish per-model figures for these models, so treat the result as an order-of-magnitude estimate. The dashboard shows a low-high band using the uncertainty multipliers.

references.label: Google (Aug 2025): median Gemini text prompt uses about 0.24 Wh, 0.03 gCO2e and 0.26 mL water
Epoch AI (2025): a typical GPT-4o query uses about 0.3 Wh
Jegham et al. (2025): How Hungry is AI? Per-query energy, water and carbon for 30 models
IEA: average global grid carbon intensity and data-center PUE
